status: draft: rules decided 2026-10-28; awaiting the full archive run
applies_to: every link of the regular LiMOSAT matching output (raw period databases), in one pass
decision_unit: one drift vector between consecutive keypoints within an original LiMOSAT trajectory
order: steps run in sequence; each step sees only links that survived the earlier steps

steps.0_SPEED: speed over the actual image gap above max_speed_m_per_day
steps.1_OPEN_WATER: SIC < open_water_sic at either endpoint (each endpoint on its own date, nearest cell); links with no SIC value are kept. Product per day: AMSR2 ASI 3.125 km, else AMSR2 ASI 6.25 km, else NOAA/NSIDC CDR v6 25 km
steps.1_LAND: deeper endpoint at least land_min_inland_km inland on the supplied 1 km inland-distance raster (land where Natural Earth 10 m and OpenStreetMap agree)
steps.2_ISOLATED_UNVERIFIED: no other surviving link of the image pair within neighbour_radius_m, and a gap longer than isolated_max_hours or a speed above isolated_max_speed_m_per_day
steps.3_ROGUE_VECTOR: leave-one-out local-affine prediction from surviving links of the exact image pair (v2 neighbour model: up to 24 within 30 km, at least 8, robust distance-weighted affine with the prediction guard) is supported, residual / max(neighbour spread, rogue_spread_floor_m) >= rogue_coherence_min, and either the residual exceeds rogue_residual_m with no corroborating neighbour, or it exceeds rogue_gross_residual_m with at most rogue_gross_max_corroborating corroborating neighbours
steps.4_INTERP_UNSUPPORTED: an endpoint interpolated, and not (at least support_min of the support_nearest nearest surviving links within support_radius_m, and the distance from their median displacement <= support_tolerance_m, or <= support_mid_tolerance_m with target_corr >= support_mid_min_corr, or <= support_hard_tolerance_m with target_corr >= support_hard_min_corr)

flags.bit_0_FEW_NEIGHBOURS: fewer than few_neighbours_min other kept links of the pair within neighbour_radius_m
flags.bit_1_LOW_PAIR_DIRECT_SHARE: pair_direct_share < low_pair_direct_share; pair_direct_share is also stored on every link

split_semantics: a removed link is dropped and the target keypoint begins a new trajectory segment; kept positions are never altered; flags never split
replaces: limosat_trajectory_link_qc_v2_20260907 (its 60 km/day speed rule is kept as step 0; its local-residual, topology and speed-local rules are covered by ROGUE_VECTOR and INTERP_UNSUPPORTED) and the v3/v3.1 drafts
